title_zh: 请康复服务安排治疗师回电

scenario.label_zh: 请康复服务安排治疗师回电
scenario.goal_zh: 说明术后日常活动困难，澄清希望先与治疗师讨论评估，并请求服务方安排回电

context_zh: 虚构术后服务沟通练习：来电者只询问评估和回电流程，对话不提供诊断或治疗方案。
author: author-phase09-b

sentences.speaker: Ruth
sentences.text: I had surgery last month, and I still struggle with ordinary things like getting dressed. I'm not sure whom to contact.

sentences.speaker: Receptionist Dan
sentences.text: Have you already spoken to the surgeon about the difficulties?

sentences.speaker: Ruth
sentences.text: Yes. She suggested I contact your service about therapy, but I don't know what the first visit involves.

sentences.speaker: Receptionist Dan
sentences.text: The therapist can explain the assessment and discuss your needs. I can ask her to call you before you book anything.

sentences.speaker: Ruth
sentences.text: Please do. I'd rather talk it through first than choose an appointment without understanding it.

sentences.speaker: Receptionist Dan
sentences.text: Certainly. Is the number on your referral still the best one?

sentences.speaker: Ruth
sentences.text: Yes, and I'm available after two this afternoon.

sentences.speaker: Receptionist Dan
sentences.text: I'll pass on that number and your availability. The therapist will need to confirm when she can call.
